newsitem.title: USA: Kaman sees U.S. defense market stiffen.
newsitem.headline: Kaman sees U.S. defense market stiffen.

text.p: Technology company Kaman Corp, which makes products for the defense, industrial and music markets, said on Thursday that competition in the U.S. defense market continued to grow.

In a statement, the company said that, while operating income within its Diversified Technologies segment grew during the second quarter, it "continued to see the level of competition increasing" in the U.S defense market.
But in foreign markets, Kaman signed contracts for SH-2G helicopters valued at nearly $800 million during the second quarter, the company said.
In addition, the government of Australia ordered 11 Super Seasprites from Kaman, while the government of New Zealand ordered four of the naval helicopters.
"Revenues and earnings from new programs will begin to come on stream during the second half of this year and will continue over the next several years," the company forecast.
Kaman posted 1997 second quarter net earnings of $6.7 million from $5.4 million a year ago.
